name: Tamarack Baumann
source:
Tamarack is full of appreciation for everything around her. She loves to collect whatever catches her eye, and she is equally happy to share her good fortune by gifting small, random objects to others. Because of that, Tamarack's always got a large bag in tow during her explorarions. 

She may be off in her own little world, but that doesn't mean there isn't space for you in it. Quite the opposite. Being a fellow newcomer gives you a better shot at reaching Tamarack than anyone else.

[From [url=https://gbpatch.itch.io/our-life-nf]itch.io[/url]]
